metadata.content: Celtic guaranteed European football, can Rangers, Hearts, Hibs and Motherwell secure Conference League place? | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Analysis Celtic guaranteed European football, can Rangers, Hearts, Hibs and Motherwell secure Conference League place? They have the cushion of Europa League football if they throw away their commanding lead against LASK in their Champions League tie, but there is no such comfort for Hearts, Rangers, Hibs and Motherwell. The Jambos have already failed in their bid to qualify for Europe's top two club competitions, and need to win away to Rapid Vienna to secure a place in the Conference League. Got Sky? City are entering the unknown after Pep Guardiola's departure, while Liverpool are rebuilding under Andoni Iraola. A last-gasp Josko Gvardiol winner handed Enzo Maresca a 2-1 win in his first Premier League game in charge of City against Bournemouth and Liverpool also left it late to draw 2-2 with Newcastle. Jockeys' Championship leader Billy Loughnane takes the ride on Nogo's Dream , whose last success came back in June of last year. However, he bounced back to form when finishing second to an unexposed and progressive type last time at Sandown. The third in that contest went onto win well subsequently and everything is pointing towards a competitive showing from this lad, with Richard Hughes' charge now five pounds below his last winning mark South Shore has been rejuvenated since moving to sprint-training specialist Robert Cowell. With form figures reading 1122 since transferring from the Ruth Carr stable, he should prove tough to beat.
